delivery_boundary.active_sprint: Sprint 3 - deterministic feasibility and concurrent allocation
delivery_boundary.ai_runtime: LangChain bind_tools plus bounded manual invoke loop
prohibited_patterns: Redis as business source of truth

non_negotiable_invariants.statement: PostgreSQL is the system of record for shipments, appointments, slots, docks, exceptions, audit, and allocation state.
The LLM may choose typed tools, but deterministic services make scheduling decisions and execute all business writes.
Never invent shipment, ETA, dock, appointment, capacity, facility, or queue facts.
Role, driver scope, facility scope, and global read-only authority come from verified Supabase Auth server-side mapping.
Displayed feasible slots are informational options, not reservations or promises.
A selected slot must be revalidated and claimed inside the same database transaction before any confirmed appointment is reported.
At most one active PENDING_CONFIRMATION, CONFIRMED, or IN_PROGRESS appointment may occupy a slot.
A shipment may have at most one active PENDING_CONFIRMATION, CONFIRMED, or IN_PROGRESS appointment.
If no compatible slot is feasible, return a reasoned escalation path instead of fabricating availability.

feasibility_hard_constraints.statement: The shipment ETA plus required unload duration must fit inside the candidate slot window.
The candidate slot must be inside the facility's operating calendar and local time-zone rules.
The dock must be active and not closed, blocked, under maintenance, or already occupied by protected work.
Vehicle type, size, weight, reefer/equipment, and dock compatibility rules must all match.
Product, special handling, hazard, temperature, and unload requirements must be compatible with the dock and facility rules.
The candidate slot must have capacity after active appointments, holds, closures, and operational reductions are applied.
Feasibility must use the latest authoritative ETA from PostgreSQL, not stale chat memory or client state.
A shipment with an active appointment can only use reschedule flow, not a second independent booking flow.

appointment_lifecycle.displayed: Feasible option shown to a user; no capacity is held.
appointment_lifecycle.selected: User selected an option in conversation; backend must still revalidate.
appointment_lifecycle.requested_or_held: A bounded hold/request exists only after an authorized transactional write.
appointment_lifecycle.pending_confirmation: Facility or workflow confirmation is pending; slot is active for conflict purposes.
appointment_lifecycle.confirmed: Appointment is committed and visible as confirmed.
appointment_lifecycle.in_progress: Truck is checked in or unloading; protected from displacement.
appointment_lifecycle.expired: Hold or pending request exceeded its TTL or validity window.
appointment_lifecycle.rejected: Facility or policy rejected the requested option.
appointment_lifecycle.cancelled: Appointment was cancelled through an authorized transition.
appointment_lifecycle.conflicted: A stale or losing selection encountered a newer authoritative state.

invalidates_displayed_options_when: appointment is created, confirmed, cancelled, expired, rejected, or conflicted
truck checks in, starts unloading, or overruns unload duration
facility rule or compatibility data changes
higher priority protected work consumes capacity

forbidden_fallbacks: ask the LLM to choose an exception override

deferred_until_after_sprint3_gate: WhatsApp, SMS, Teams, Slack, or voice channels
